Alex, the Big Apple brawler, will make his descent into the ring of Street Fighter 6 on March 17!

No use holding back when faced with the Dark Devil himself, as he'll show you no mercy with his array of devastatingly powerful throws!

Alex can be purchased individually with Fighter Coins and the owners of the Year 3 Character Pass / Ultimate Pass will automatically get access to Alex when he releases.

Bubblegum Galaxy is a cozy narrative hexagon tile building game about rebuilding the galaxy by designing planets. 

Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... Relax as you create colourful planets or spend hours trying to get a perfect score!

Launching March 12 on PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4!
